about: REAL yearly figures from official sources. The AI's market history must be within allowed_difference of each one. Every row needs a source link. Rows with real_change_pct = null are ignored until you fill them in.
how_to_fill: real_change_pct is the % change over that year. For growth rates (e.g. GDP) copy the published figure. For an index or price, work it out from the official levels: (this year / last year - 1) x 100. market_match is a pattern matched against the AI's market description, so 'singapore.*(gdp|econom)' finds the AI's Singapore economy market whatever id it gave it.
